==Russian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|ru|дѣли́ть||ru-PRO}}

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*děliti||to divide}}, from {{der|ru|ine-bsl-pro|*doyl-}}, from {{der|ru|ine-pro|*dʰayl-}}, {{m|ine-pro|*dʰoyl-}}. Cognates include {{cog|ang|dǣlan}} ({{cog|en|deal}}) and {{cog|lt|dailyti}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|дели́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-делить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|дели́ть|impf|pf=подели́ть,раздели́ть|vn=деле́ние<t:division, partition>,делёж<t:sharing out, distribution>}}

# to [[divide]]
#: {{syn|ru|разделя́ть|разъединя́ть|расчленя́ть|разнима́ть}}
# to [[share]], to [[exchange]]
# to [[confide]], to [[tell]]
